description_en: Create a live stream snapshot template to facilitate the creation of snapshot jobs
description_zh: 调用CreateLiveSnapshotTemplate创建实时截图模板，模板便于创建截图任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-live-snapshot-template --template-name Template_1 --overwrite-format snapshot/_JobId_.jpg --sequence-format snapshot/_JobId_/_UnixTimestamp_.jpg --time-interval 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveSnapshotTemplate

parameters.description_en:
The name of the template.

- It cannot exceed 128 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
模板名称。
- 最大长度为128。
parameters.help_en:
The name of the template.

- It cannot exceed 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
模板名称。
- 最大长度为128
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.description_en:
The naming format of the snapshot captured in overwrite mode.

- The value cannot start with a forward slash (/). Only the suffix .jpg is supported.

- It cannot exceed 255 characters in length.

- The {JobId} placeholder is supported. It specifies the ID of the snapshot job.

- Placeholders such as {UnixTimestamp}, {Sequence}, and {Date} are not allowed.

- You must specify at least one of the OverwriteFormat and SequenceFormat parameters.
parameters.description_zh:
覆盖截图文件格式。

- 不能以“/”开头，目前只支持.jpg后缀。
- 最大长度为255。
- 支持占位符： {JobId}：截图任务ID
- 不允许填写{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}、{Date}等占位符。
- 覆盖截图和序列截图的文件格式至少要设置一个。

parameters.name: overwrite_format

parameters.description_en:
The naming format of the snapshot captured in time series mode.

- The value cannot start with a forward slash (/). Only the suffix .jpg is supported.

- It cannot exceed 255 characters in length.

- The {JobId}, {Date}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence} placeholders are supported. {JobId} specifies the ID of the snapshot job. {Date} specifies the date on which the snapshot is captured. {UnixTimestamp} specifies the timestamp of the snapshot. {Sequence} specifies the sequence number of the snapshot. You must specify at least one of the {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} placeholders.

- You must specify at least one of the OverwriteFormat and SequenceFormat parameters.
parameters.description_zh:
序列截图文件格式。
- 不能以“/”开头，目前只支持.jpg后缀。
- 最大长度为255。
- 支持占位符：{JobId}：截图任务ID、{Date}：截图日期、{UnixTimestamp}：时间戳、{Sequence}：序列号，其中{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}至少要填写一个。
- 覆盖截图和序列截图的文件格式至少要设置一个。

parameters.description_en:
The interval between two adjacent snapshots. Unit: seconds.

- Valid values: \[5,3600].
parameters.description_zh:
截图时间间隔，单位：秒。
- 取值范围是[5, 3600]。
